entry.title: Fraction Complete
entry.summary:
Vendor: Eraform, Prototype
Type: Sound Plugin
Price: 159.00

The Fraction Complete Bundle contains all current paid expansions and the engine itself at a more affordable price point.

After more than a year in development, this is our first-ever VST and it changes the way a plugin feels inside your DAW. 

Fraction is a sample based engine built from Pure Hardware but with Unmatched Controls unlike anything ever before.

Synths, instruments, and pedals worth more than $80k that we used to make Fraction happen. 

But Fraction is more than Hardware Sound. It’s about unmatched control. With features like the Algorythm XY Pad, Fractalize, Vintage, Color, Smooth, and Humanize, every preset becomes a playground you can bend, twist, and shape in seconds.

This video walks you through Fraction, what makes it different, and why it’s more than just another VST.

🔥 Full Bundle includes:

  • 580+ presets / 350+ sound sources

  • Multi-velocity sampling (up to 500 wavs per preset)

  • Pure Hardware Sound: Prophet, Juno, Moog, Arturia, Polybrute & more

  • Custom controls never seen before in a VST such as The Algorythm, Color, Vintage, Fractalize and more

  • Lifetime free updates — new presets and expansions included

Forming a new Era of Musical Software. 

Fraction is now available at eraformaudio.com .

entry.title: Fraction
entry.summary:
Vendor: Eraform, Prototype
Type: Sound Plugin
Price: 93.00

Fraction is here. 
After more than a year in development, this is our first-ever VST and it changes the way a plugin feels inside your DAW. 

Fraction is a sample based engine built from Pure Hardware but with Unmatched Controls unlike anything ever before.

We sampled every note from real hardware and 16,000 sound recordings later, we spread them across 360 presets and 250 sound sources you can choose from. Synths, instruments, and pedals worth more than $80k that we used to make Fraction happen. No stretching, no shortcuts.

But Fraction is more than Hardware Sound. It’s about unmatched control. With features like the Algorythm XY Pad, Fractalize, Vintage, Color, Smooth, and Humanize, every preset becomes a playground you can bend, twist, and shape in seconds.

This video walks you through Fraction, what makes it different, and why it’s more than just another VST.

🔥 Highlights:

  • 360+ presets / 250+ sound sources

  • Multi-velocity, Per Note sampling (up to 500 wavs per preset)

  • Pure Hardware Sound: Prophet, Juno, Moog, Arturia, Polybrute & more

  • Custom controls never seen before in a VST such as The Algorythm, Color, Vintage, Fractalize and more

  • Lifetime free updates — new presets and expansions included

Forming a new Era of Musical Software. 

Fraction is now available at eraformaudio.com .
